display.purpose: Hero greeting, page-level statements. One per screen. Always sentence case.

display-italic.purpose: Section headings with dosha emphasis. Mix of 300 and 400 within one heading is intentional.

heading.purpose: Card titles, coaching category headers, modal titles.

body-serif.purpose: AI coaching text, philosophical copy, in-practice guidance. Always italic. Max 65ch.

body.purpose: UI descriptions, input placeholder, secondary information. Max 70ch.

label.purpose: Badge text, tab labels, section markers, chip text. The instrument-readout register. Always uppercase.

micro.purpose: Footer, sub-badges, status chips. Maximum one use per screen. Always uppercase.

timer.purpose: Breathwork countdown displays only. This register exists nowhere else in the system.

shadows.name: lift-subtle
shadows.purpose: Default lift under Soma input capsule and primary coaching cards.

shadows.name: lift-lavender
shadows.purpose: Hover state on the Soma input — a lavender-tinted bloom signalling readiness.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Default. Glass surfaces are shadow-free at rest.

motion.name: ease-breath
motion.purpose: Breathing lotus and ambient pulsing — slow, body-aware rhythms.

motion.name: duration-std
motion.purpose: Standard state changes: hover color, background shift.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Page transitions, modal entry, view switches.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Welcome screen stacks to single column; header collapses.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Coaching dashboard switches from single to two-column layout.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Max content width kicks in; side panels become visible.

narrative.overview:
PranaVeda is designed to be a daily object, not a destination. Like a beautifully made journal or a precision health instrument — Oura ring energy in software — it exists to be used, then forgotten. Every screen is engineered to disappear: to surface the practice, the breath, the body, and then step aside. The interface does not celebrate itself.

The aesthetic draws from Apple Health's clinical data clarity, Oura's body-intelligence restraint, Calm's breath-aware motion, and Neo Mirai's editorial minimalism. The result is neither a meditation app nor a wellness dashboard. It is a ritual companion with a quiet, authoritative voice — one that knows something about your body and is calm about it.

Glass surfaces carry all the atmospheric weight. Playfair Display carries the sacred intelligence. Together they create the sensation of reading a beautifully typeset prescription written just for you. Sacred geometry, mystical iconography, and temple aesthetics are explicitly rejected.
keyCharacteristics: Glassmorphic surfaces used structurally, never decoratively
Playfair Display + monospace label system creates the editorial-intelligence contrast axis
Motion is slow, body-aware, and always reducible — it breathes, it does not perform
Four dosha-mapped color tints carry semantic meaning; never purely decorative
White space is active — silence is the brand voice

rules.name: The Tint Semantics Rule
rules.body: The four dosha tints (#E8E1F2, #FBEDE9, #DDF5EE, #DFE8FA) are semantic signals, not ambient color. Each maps to a dosha state surfaced in AI responses. Never apply them as general background fills or for visual interest alone.

rules.name: The Lavender Restraint Rule
rules.body: Sacred Lavender (#8A79A5) covers ≤20% of any given screen. One active state. One brand moment. Its scarcity is what makes it feel intentional.

rules.name: The Register Contrast Rule
rules.body: Every typographic composition must cross at least two registers: Playfair prose + mono label, or display serif + body sans. Never place two mono-only or two serif-only elements at the same hierarchy level.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Display and heading text is always sentence case. UPPERCASE is reserved exclusively for Label and Micro registers. Uppercase Playfair Display is prohibited.

rules.name: The Purposeful Glass Rule
rules.body: Every backdrop-filter: blur() in the UI has a structural job: separating one layer from the ambient background. If removing the blur doesn't change the perceived hierarchy, it doesn't belong.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass cards are never nested inside other glass cards. When a card already has backdrop-filter, its children use opaque or transparent backgrounds only.

dos: Do use Sacred Lavender (#8A79A5) for active states, labels, and brand moments only — its scarcity signals importance.
Do use Playfair Display in sentence case for all display and heading text, including italic emphasis.
Do reserve the mono uppercase Label register for instrument-readout contexts: badge text, tab labels, section markers, chip text, and metadata lines only.
Do pair every breathing or ambient animation with a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) fallback — typically an instant crossfade or opacity transition.
Do maintain the glass hierarchy: inputs at white/60%, primary cards at white/55%, nav and chips at white/40%.
Do cap Body Serif text at 65ch and Body Sans at 70ch. Apply text-wrap: balance to Display and Heading elements.
Do use the four dosha tints semantically — only in coaching contexts where a dosha state is explicitly identified by the AI.
donts: Don't use generic SaaS or dashboard patterns: no metric hero cards with big numbers and small stat labels, no persistent sidebar navigation, no layouts with multiple competing primary CTAs.
Don't use fast-energy or gym-app motion: no bounce easing, no staggered section entrances with identical timing, no urgency-signaling countdowns outside the breathwork timer.

Don't make the UI feel like a chat interface or AI conversation thread. Coaching outputs are structured ritual compositions — complete, beautiful, and presented as a whole — never as conversational bubbles.
Don't use fantasy or mystical visual language: no temple imagery, sacred geometry overlays, mandala backgrounds, glowing orbs, or heavy spiritual iconography.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Every backdrop-filter: blur() must have a structural hierarchy job.
Don't nest glass cards inside glass cards. The No-Nested-Glass Rule is absolute.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text + gradient background). Emphasis is weight or size only.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent on any card, list item, or callout.
Don't uppercase Playfair Display at any size. Uppercase is the mono register's territory only.
